name: openmbd_football
citation: Tierney. OpenMBD: An Open-Source Multibody Dynamics Simulator for Biomechanics Research and Education. F1000Research, 2026.
description: Size 5 association football (single rigid body, one spherical ellipsoid) with literature-average properties.

metadata.name: OpenMBD Football Model
metadata.description: Size 5 football: literature-average mass, size, stiffness and restitution.

properties.mass: 0.430 kg: midpoint of the Laws of the Game size 5 range 410-450 g (IFAB Law 2); measured size 5 balls 0.43-0.44 kg (Shewchenko et al. 2005; Auger et al. 2020)
properties.radius: 0.1098 m: circumference 0.69 m, midpoint of the Laws of the Game range 0.68-0.70 m (IFAB Law 2)
properties.inertia: 0.003457 kg m^2: thin spherical shell, 2/3 m r^2
properties.stiffness: 31.6 kN/m linear: mean of four size 5 match balls, 25.9-36.7 kN/m (Shewchenko et al. 2005); within 22.1-28.1 N/mm (Queen et al. 2003) to 25-45 kN/m (Tierney et al. 2021) ranges
properties.restitution: unloading curve = 0.70 x loading curve with steep hysteresis slope, giving a coefficient of restitution of about 0.84, the midpoint of the 1.25-1.55 m rebound required from a 2 m drop (FIFA Quality Programme, summarised by Mills 2024)
properties.inflation_pressure: not modelled explicitly; stiffness corresponds to match balls at nominal pressure (Laws of the Game range 0.6-1.1 atm)

metadata.usage: Contact settings (simulation-wide): coefficient of friction 0.4 (boot-ball 0.38, Tan et al. 2020; ball on leather 0.37-0.62). Contact damping 15 N s/m for kicking: with the right-leg model at 18.6 m/s this gives a foot-ball coefficient of restitution of 0.59, contact time 11.5 ms and ball/foot speed ratio 1.39 (measured: e 0.58, Dorge et al. 2002; contact 9-12 ms, Nunome et al. 2012). Contact damping 0 N s/m for ball-ground bounce only (2 m drop rebound 1.41 m); with 15 N s/m the 2 m drop rebound falls to 0.92 m (e 0.68). The default 150 N s/m is far too high for a 0.43 kg ball (foot-ball e 0.12).
metadata.limitations: Linear, rate-independent contact; restitution does not fall with impact speed (measured falls of about 0.2 over 30 m/s, Price 2005 cited by Mills 2024); no aerodynamic drag or lift; rigid-body spin with no shell deformation coupling.
sources: IFAB. Laws of the Game 2024/25, Law 2 - The Ball. International Football Association Board, Zurich.
